CONNECT_NO_FIVEM: Sign in to your FiveM (Cfx.re) account to join this server.
CHAR_CREATE_SUBTITLE: Slot {0}. You can change your look after you spawn.
CHAR_DELETE_TEXT: Their money, jobs, gangs and everything they own go with them. This cannot be undone.
CHAR_ERR_BUSY: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
CHAR_ERR_INVALID: Check the form and try again.
CHAR_ERR_BIRTHDATE: Pick a date of birth for an age between 18 and 100.
CHAR_ERR_LIMIT: All character slots are in use.
CHAR_ERR_ONLINE: This character is already in the game.
CHAR_ERR_NO_DELETE: Deleting characters is turned off on this server.
ADMIN_EMPTY_LIST: Nothing here yet. Use the button above to add the first one.
ADMIN_PICK_RECORD: Pick one from the list to edit it.
ADMIN_CREATE_DESC: Give it a name. Everything else can be set after it is created.
ADMIN_DELETE_DESC: It is removed for everyone at once. Players who have it keep the old value until it is set again.
ADMIN_H_KEY: Saved under this key and used by scripts. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
ADMIN_ERR_TYPE: This value is not valid here.
ADMIN_ERR_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
ADMIN_ERR_LENGTH: This text is too short or too long.
ADMIN_ERR_PATTERN: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
ADMIN_ERR_EXISTS: Something with this key already exists. Pick another key.
ADMIN_ERR_LOCKED: This one is built in and cannot be deleted.
ADMIN_ERR_DENIED: You no longer have admin rights.
ADMIN_ERR_RATE: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
ADMIN_ERR_GONE: This script is not running right now.
ADMIN_ERR_BUSY: Unable to save. Check your connection and try again.
ADMIN_TAB_GENERAL_DESC: The server name players see, character slots and how often the game saves.
ADMIN_TAB_SCENE_DESC: The place in the world behind the character screen, where each player's characters stand.
ADMIN_TAB_RULES_DESC: How many jobs and gangs a character may hold and how salaries are paid.
ADMIN_TAB_JOBS_DESC: Every job on the server with its ranks and salaries.
ADMIN_TAB_GANGS_DESC: Every gang on the server with its ranks.
ADMIN_TAB_ACCOUNTS_DESC: The kinds of money every character has and what a new character starts with.
ADMIN_C_BRANDING_DESC: Shown at the top of the character screen and other full screen menus.
ADMIN_PH_TAGLINE_SUB: e.g. People, stories, a second chance
ADMIN_H_BACKGROUND: Shown behind the character screen only when its scene cannot be loaded.
ADMIN_C_CHARACTERS_DESC: How many characters an account may have and who may create one.
ADMIN_H_SLOTS: Slots on the character screen for every account.
ADMIN_H_CAN_DELETE: Off hides the delete button on the character screen.
ADMIN_C_SAVING_DESC: Positions and other small changes are saved together on this interval. Money is always saved at once.
ADMIN_C_INVENTORY_DESC: Every script gives, takes and checks items through this inventory.
ADMIN_H_INVENTORY: Automatic uses the first one that runs. A picked inventory that is not started leaves every item action failing until it starts.
ADMIN_TAB_EXTERNAL_DESC: Settings screens of other scripts, listed on the dashboard next to the ai-* scripts.
ADMIN_C_EXTERNAL_DESC: How the dashboard opens this script's own settings: its command, or its page shown inside the panel.
ADMIN_H_EXT_RESOURCE: Resource name; the card shows only while it is started. Leave empty for a page that belongs to no script.
ADMIN_H_EXT_COMMAND: The command that opens the script's own panel. ai-core's panel closes and runs it for you.
ADMIN_H_EXT_URL: An https page shown inside the panel (a script's NUI page: https://cfx-nui-<script>/...). Pages that need their own script's messages work only through the command.
ADMIN_DASHBOARD_DESC: Every script with settings. Search finds scripts, tabs and settings.
ADMIN_FREECAM_HELP: WASD move · Q/E down/up · Shift fast · mouse look · scroll rotate · Enter place · Backspace cancel
ADMIN_BLIP_SEARCH: Search icons by name or number
ADMIN_ERR_LOOKUP: Pick a value that exists in the game.
ADMIN_LOOKUP_EMPTY: No match. Only existing values can be picked.
ADMIN_C_CONFLICTS_DESC: When a script that replaces another runs (tgiann-inventory instead of ai-inventory), the console names the folder to delete.
ADMIN_H_REFUSE_ON_CONFLICT: Nobody can join while an unneeded script is started next to its replacement; the refusal and the console say which one to remove.
CONNECT_CONFLICT: This server is not set up correctly: {0} must be removed because another script replaces it. Tell the server owner.
ADMIN_C_INTERACTION_DESC: How players use shops, counters, NPCs and other points of every script.
ADMIN_H_INTERACTION: Prompt: a box on the right and the interaction key when close. Target: players hold the target key and pick the option on the point or NPC (needs a target script such as ai-target; without one the prompt is used).
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_KEYS_DESC: Every script gives, takes and checks vehicle keys through this key system.
ADMIN_H_VEHICLE_KEYS: Automatic uses the first one that runs. While no key script runs, every player counts as holding every key.
ADMIN_C_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC: Where a new character appears after it is created.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_LOOK_DESC: Camera zoom, and the time and weather players see while they pick a character.
ADMIN_H_FOV: Smaller is closer. 50 is a good start.
ADMIN_H_SCENE_TIME: Off shows the server's current time and weather.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_SPOTS_DESC: Spot 1 holds the character of slot 1, and so on. A character in a slot without a spot appears on a spot only while it is picked.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_CAMERAS_DESC: How the camera frames the character on each spot when it is picked.
ADMIN_H_CAM_HEIGHT: 0 is level with the look point, 0.5 raises the camera by half the distance, below 0 looks up.
ADMIN_H_CAM_ANGLE: 0 is straight in front of the character, 90 its left side, -90 its right side.
ADMIN_H_SWAY: How far the camera slowly swings left and right. 0 keeps it still.
ADMIN_C_SCENE_BLUR_DESC: Blurs what is nearer or farther than the character, like a photo lens.
ADMIN_H_BLUR: Sharp from the near distance to the far distance from the camera, blurred outside.
ADMIN_C_JOB_RULES_DESC: A character works one job at a time; salary comes only from the job they are on duty in.
ADMIN_H_MULTI_JOB: Off: a new job replaces the old one.
ADMIN_H_RESTORE_DUTY: Off: every player starts off duty.
ADMIN_C_GANG_RULES_DESC: A character can be in several gangs but acts for one active gang at a time.
ADMIN_C_PAYCHECK_DESC: Players on duty are paid the salary of their rank on this interval.
ADMIN_F_FROM_JOB_ACCOUNT: Pay from the job's own money
ADMIN_H_FROM_JOB_ACCOUNT: Off: the server pays. On: the job account pays, and nobody is paid when it is empty.
ADMIN_H_JOB_TYPE: Groups jobs for other scripts, e.g. leo for every police job, ems for medics.
ADMIN_H_DEFAULT_DUTY: Players start this job on duty instead of off duty.
ADMIN_C_GRADES_DESC: From the lowest to the highest rank. The salary is paid on every paycheck while on duty.
ADMIN_C_GANG_GRADES_DESC: From the lowest to the highest rank.
ADMIN_H_START: What a new character has in this account.
ADMIN_H_NEGATIVE: On: spending is allowed with an empty account (debt).
KEYBIND_INTERACT: Interact with the prompt on screen
ADMIN_TAB_KEYBINDS_DESC: The key every script's action starts on; players can still change theirs in GTA settings.
ADMIN_C_KEYBIND_DESC: The script sets a default key; set another one here to give every player a different starting key.
ADMIN_H_DEFAULT_KEY: Empty uses the script's key. A new key reaches every player (also those who had changed the old one) the next time the script starts or they reconnect; players can still rebind it in GTA Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM.
ADMIN_ERR_KEY: Unknown key name for this device. Keyboard: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, TAB, LSHIFT, LMENU (Alt), RETURN, BACK. Mouse: MOUSE_LEFT, MOUSE_RIGHT, MOUSE_MIDDLE.
ADMIN_TAB_COMMANDS_DESC: Every command on the server: what it does, how to type it and who may use it.
COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED: You are not allowed to use this command.
COMMAND_PLAYER: No player is online with id {0}.
COMMAND_AICORE_JOB: Give a job at a grade
COMMAND_AICORE_DUTY: Go on duty in a job (off = off duty)
COMMAND_AICORE_MONEY: Add to an account (a negative amount takes)
COMMAND_AICORE_GANG: Give a gang at a grade
COMMAND_AICORE_DB: Database statistics of every resource in the server console
COMMAND_P_ID: Server id of the player (default: you)
